facts.name: BattleCharMgr_SnapshotFlaggedEntries
facts.note: void(snap): the IDA pass ENEMYLEADER on both databases; fills a 0x1820-byte snapshot of the battle's flagged characters (index +8, 48-byte entries +0x10, heap +0x1810, count +0x1818) and skips to the first live EndCharacter.

facts.name: BattleCharSnapshot_SkipToLiveEndCharacter
facts.note: void(snap): steps the index past null, pending-kill and non-EndCharacter entries.

facts.name: AIControllerBP_CallOnChangeLeader
facts.note: void(controller, oldLeader): ProcessEvent of the blueprint event OnChangeLeader; its only caller is BattleLeader_ExecuteChange.
